question: What alternative expiation applies when a person is unable to perform a very difficult act?
premises: Some expiatory acts are very difficult to perform oneself.
A person may be unable to perform such an act.
An alternative double measure is prescribed in that case.
inference: One unable to perform a very difficult expiation himself must follow the prescribed double alternative.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the double measure is clarified in following verses.
plain_english: One who is unable to perform a very difficult act himself must follow the prescribed double alternative.
